scenario.title: Operator-maintained private distributions
situations: Use a private Yoke fork or package host.
A private relay cannot fetch the exact server release.
A fork operator asks what upstream supports.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: No private artifact host, real relay fetch, or fork upgrade was exercised.

lessons.title: Bind the first download and future updates
lessons.when: Before installing from a private distribution
lessons.need: Fetch that distribution installer and bind the same credential-free origin/channel from the first download. The package host may differ from the API host; later updates use the persisted record.
lessons.surface: Public index Read next and CLI/config -> Maintaining a private fork.

lessons.title: Know the supported boundary and fetch recovery
lessons.when: Publishing a fork build or resolving relay_release_fetch_failed
lessons.need: Operator supplies compatible immutable installer/channel/wheels/index/image. Relay needs the server exact immutable version, not another channel guess. Upstream hosted publishing and automatic fork/migration governance are outside this contract.
lessons.surface: Private forks guide -> artifact requirements, relay status recovery and Unsupported at this level.
